target_capacity.limits: Target cache policy/config remains identical; observed elastic capacity may vary. Events are reported, never calibrated away or subtracted from decode.

allocation.scope: All modes retain the maximum HQ slab and pre-captured resources. Autoelastic target policy is unchanged; observed target capacity varies and resize work remains inside decode.

timing.upload: HQ mode upload is before prompt and decode timers; measured independently and included in outer GEN wall.
timing.restore: SSD read/validation/upload and suffix prefill are inside prompt work, outside decode. Their timers overlap; do not sum them or normalize TPS.
timing.elastic: Elastic growth/shrink occurs inside decode; never subtracted.
timing.temperature: No normalization for clocks, thermal state, cache warming or overlapping CPU/GPU/PCIe work.

errors_and_limits: Fixed target continuation, not free-generation quality. Q2native changes layout/kernel activation path; Q4native changes weight quantization as well.
Identical policy trace instrumentation in all32 modes. Host observations/buffer stores add overhead; positive signals require a free, untraced follow-up.
Local draft/raw-target agreement is conditioned on the forced context. After a raw/fixture divergence, later rows are not the global greedy continuation. B repeats are not independent samples.
The slab/scratch allocation and target cache policy are common; elastic target capacity may change and is reported, not normalized.
Pack hashes were computed at prepare; engine reports declared identity and host graph-family counts, not physical CUDA kernel counts.
Uploads are outside prompt/decode timers. Wall GEN and upload_ms remain separate; no overlapping timer subtraction.
One B/A/B block per comparison/case; warmup and smoke are functional checks.
All 32 requests use a fixed target continuation and policy trace. Reported gains are diagnostic, not a free or uninstrumented performance result.
Raw target/fixture divergence censors global greedy interpretation at its first output index. Later comparisons remain local to forced contexts.
Local raw-prefix histograms stop at first mismatch and separately label right censoring; they are not full free-generation survival.
B repeats use the same cases/fixtures and are not independent statistical samples. Only two cases and one order were measured.
Q2native changes activation quantization and kernel path although sampled weight values are identical. Q4 also changes weight quantization.
Dispatch counters prove the selected host graph family, not independently counted device kernels.
Cache growth/shrink and PLE warming are observed confounders, preserved without calibration or subtraction.
Whole-run desktop telemetry is archived; it is not attributed to decode without phase alignment.
Exporter/review manifests record earlier pre-build states; final build.json and completed result supersede their pending build/run booleans.
No payload or cache was reread or hashed for this analysis. Payload provenance inherits frozen prepare and bounded numerical validation.
